scope: Tractable implementation and numerical correctness only, synthetic fixtures explicitly not experimental findings
prior_gate: R0-TRIAL-1-CODE-1 PASS with independent review clearance
counts: integer nonnegative observed counts; log expected counts per100ms, exact log factorial; no intensity clipping
likelihood: joint one-step population predictive log likelihood conditional on observed past, normalized by actual unit-bin count, trial resets
common_offset: Combined own-history/context/drift Poisson GLM fitted on training only; fixed offset shared across every dynamical family

fixture.context: known elapsed-bin coordinate and bin0 onset pulse, no duplicate context intercept; trial positions fixed before simulation
fixture.generator: independent Poisson counts with exp(-0.3+0.1*elapsed_coordinate); controlled software fixture only

optimization.normalization: negative total training log likelihood divided by observed unit-bin count plus ridge times half squared coefficients
optimization.failure: retain every run; any mandatory fit nonconvergence/nonfinite/score error stops R1, never drop seeds or families
optimization.purpose: Validate optimizer implementation on controlled fixtures, not rank models

parameter_accounting: State prior/transition reference-logit gauge uses K-1 plus K*(K-1) free logits; emissions K*U plus hybrid K*U*L; recurrent d*d+d*U+d*X+U*d; GLM U*F; shared GLM parameters reported separately

oracles: current/future count perturbation and trial-reset checks
verification.failure: Any required numerical check fails, preserve all evidence and stop

comparison_policy: All seeds, configurations and ridges retained. Equal observed units/bins, identical shared training-only offset, full free parameter counts and same optimization budget; one-SE/complexity frontier selection reserved for exposed development R2, never fixture winners or external retuning
reproduction: Register source hashes and preceding artifact hashes before tests/fits; preserve immutable run evidence and verify saved-output replay before any fresh fixture run
